runtime_patches.scope: Resample an object name only when the upstream double-sampling bug produces a collision; generation and scoring logic are unchanged.
Ignore only tile-orientation keywords that Infinigen room_walls passes to Concrete.generate, which otherwise raises a deterministic TypeError; the sampled Concrete material is preserved.

notes: The local working tree has no usable .git metadata; the upstream reference commit is from the neighboring full checkout and the experiment records local source hashes separately.
A runtime-only, baselines-local compatibility patch prevents a rare duplicate object-name assertion in Infinigen 1.19.1; the upstream source tree remains read-only.

Pilot living-room and kitchen seed 1 exposed an upstream Concrete.generate keyword mismatch during room-wall decoration. A second baselines-local runtime patch fixes only that deterministic call-signature error; each failed attempt 1 is retained, and the same seeds succeeded on attempt 2.

The frozen 5x2 pilot produced 9 validator-valid runs and one preregistered image-validator quality failure (dining-room seed 1, a nearly black anchor); the quality failure was not retried. The living-room and kitchen compatibility failures both succeeded on the same seeds after applying the frozen Concrete keyword patch.

Pilot attempts with the official room OcMesher enabled were not resource-stable for the frozen 50-pose trajectory: one room shell alone exceeded 12.9M vertices and Blender was externally killed before saving. The official compose_indoors.enable_ocmesh_room switch is therefore disabled for every Infinigen run; original room meshes, furniture, materials, solve budgets, seeds and camera trajectories are unchanged.
Blender lossless .blend compression is enabled before generation to reduce artifact storage; it does not alter scene content or renders.

The common indoor renderer preserves Infinigen's collision-checked XY trajectory and per-frame forward vector, fixes world-space camera height to 1.55 m, and reconstructs camera up from global +Z to remove random roll. This pilot revision is applied uniformly before any formal matrix renders; the pre-revision bedroom seed-0 render is invalidated and rerendered.
Only the room category can be compiled into Infinigen's native interface. Prompt facts unsupported by the native interface remain in the blinded prompt-alignment evaluation.
WorldBridge is disabled for this baseline-only phase.

worldgen.identity_note: This entry is the public ZiYang-xie/WorldGen project, not Meta Reality Labs' CVPR 2026 system of the same name.
notes: The upstream public API fixes panorama seed 42. The adapter calls the same upstream gen_pano_image function with logical seeds 0,1,2,3.
The public text interface cannot ingest structured room dimensions or road topology; those requirements remain in blinded prompt-alignment scoring.
DA-2 normalizes every panorama's maximum radial depth to 20, so camera translations are declared in native normalized units rather than falsely labeled meters.
The official experimental ml-sharp and background-inpainting paths are disabled for every run.
FLUX.1-dev revision 3de623fc3c33e44ffbe2bad470d0f45bccf2eb21 is cached locally; all seven core weight files were independently SHA-256 verified before GPU execution.

A two-call source compatibility patch supplies the already-local LoRA filename explicitly because Diffusers 0.33.1 requires weight_name in offline mode; model weights and generation parameters are unchanged.
The first real indoor seed-0 smoke run completed the 50-step panorama, DA-2 reconstruction, and 8-anchor/50-frame gsplat validator successfully on physical GPU 1.
The frozen 5-spec-per-domain x 2-seed pilot completed 20/20 panoramas, reconstructions, 8-anchor/50-frame renders, and validators successfully.

Before formal freezing, uniform urban path calibration on all ten pilot splats selected [-0.60,0,-0.30] to [0,0,0]: 10/10 runs passed the image and path validator twice, and DROID-SLAM confirmed nonzero trackable parallax. The indoor path remains [-0.60,0,-0.30] to [0.60,0,0.30].

Pilot metric sanity passed for cached Q-Align, CLIP-IQA+, ADE20K SegFormer, LPIPS, and DROID-SLAM/WorldScore. WorldScore reuses the already verified baselines-local GLIBC 2.31 ABI artifacts recorded above.
The formal protocol status and all implementation hashes were frozen only after the pilot completed; formal outputs are written separately under baselines/data/table2.
Formal and pilot runs reject the official tiny pack; it is accepted only in a separate smoke output root.
Four-way and T-junction map directly to X/T; other shared topologies use preregistered compound approximations and remain subject to blinded prompt-alignment scoring.
Three normalized tiny-asset smoke runs passed on NVIDIA L40S, including the compound TT and CX map sequences.
The automated metric chain passed a GPU smoke test, including 50-frame DROID-SLAM/WorldScore through a MetaUrban-local GLIBC compatibility copy; smoke scores are explicitly excluded from Table 2.
MetaUrban render and metric subprocesses remove all upper- and lower-case proxy variables before execution.
The full static asset archive is password protected after registration. The server cannot directly connect to Google Drive when all proxy variables are disabled, so no formal run has started.
WorldBridge and every other comparison method are disabled for this MetaUrban-only task.

Official code, isolated environment and all required model assets are staged below baselines; generation workers run with proxy variables removed and Hugging Face/Diffusers/Torch Hub forced to pinned local snapshots.
SynCity exposes no metric scale or navigation mesh, so the preregistered native-trajectory exception uses a scale-normalized translated arc around the complete dimetric scene.
The first real indoor pilot run produced scene_color_adjusted.ply, 50 sequence frames, 8 anchors and valid camera metadata; the output validator passed.
The successful migrated pilot artifact is eligible for hard-link promotion into the formal data root because its source commit, spec, native input, renderer and seed match the frozen configuration.

Storage-only amendment on 2026-09-11: after validating the color-adjusted primary PLY and terminal manifest, redundant pre-color scene/scene.ply intermediates are removed. This does not alter generation, rendering, success classification or metrics; the pruner records every removed path and byte count.

Runtime portability amendment on 2026-09-11: the matrix runner no longer forces the previous machine's TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=8.9 and instead lets PyTorch compile gsplat for the single visible GPU. On this RTX A6000 host the native sm_86 build reproduced the frozen 1024-pixel color render and repaired the affected raw PLYs without repeating 3D generation; model weights, prompts, seeds, camera parameters, output resolution and metric protocol are unchanged.

ITT terminal-state amendment on 2026-09-12: after three byte-identical seeded attempts reproduced the upstream Structured Latent empty-sparse-tensor exception, the runner classifies only that exact recognized signature as a generation method quality failure and assigns the preregistered ITT zero. Unknown generation errors remain infrastructure failures. The auditor and two regression tests enforce this distinction; no successful output, prompt, seed, weight or renderer setting was changed.
WorldBridge and every comparison method other than SynCity 3000 are disabled for this task.

Metric storage portability amendment on 2026-09-13: migrated successful run directories are read-only under their original UID, so ADE20K maps and per-scene metric JSON/log files are written to baselines/work/syncity3k mirrors while all RGB, cameras and manifests remain read-only inputs. The evaluator algorithms, checkpoints, seeds and aggregate result paths are unchanged.

WorldScore result-write repair on 2026-09-13: the first DROID pass completed inference but attempted to express a mirrored log path relative to the read-only source run, discarding the in-memory error and recording infrastructure zeros. The path base was corrected, successful artifacts gained identity-checked resume caching, and process-unique temporary names prevent concurrent writer races. Only WorldScore was rerun; the final artifacts contain 197 measured successes and the three preregistered generation-failure ITT zeros. The related adapter/WorldScore/aggregate regression suite passed 29/29.
